features.title: See what this setup can do and what it still needs on one page
features.summary: Knowledge › Getting started (also in the command palette and the New tab view chooser) shows a self-ticking setup checklist read live from the Host (AI account configured, project added, project is a jj or git repository, GitHub CLI signed in) with a fix action for each open item, the eight plugin packs with every plugin enabled, disabled or not installed plus its prerequisites and key settings, and a curated-first search over every catalogued feature grouped by destination, with an Open button only where the route is registered. The onboarding_overview agent tool returns the same checklist, packs and rows. It changes nothing.

failureModes: A Host without the model service, workspace registry or plugin manager reports that item or plugin as unknown instead of guessing.

features.title: Get set up in three steps: account, project, first task
features.summary: While no thread is open, a three-step setup wizard links to AI accounts, Settings › Projects and workspace isolation, ticks each step from the live checklist, and ends by inserting a starter prompt into the composer without sending it. Skip, Back and Next on every step; the outcome is kept per browser. Onboarding: Show the setup wizard and Start setup on Getting started replay it. It makes no model request.
